positive.hypothesis: the causal 5D up-rate is a better 5-session estimator than a momentum-conditioned hit rate; it is shrunk toward a volatility-calibrated drift prior
positive.wilson_interval_method: Wilson score on the raw matching hit frequency; nominal IID approximation with overlapping labels; not a confidence interval for the shrunk probability
positive.rationale: The causal base rate 0.5020 is measured on 255 matured 5D labels and shrunk toward p_vol=0.5184 with k=50; n_eff=51.0. The ROC20 state is disclosed for context only.

validation.method: drift-shrunk causal base rate on a prefix walk-forward ledger; fixed 52-week window; no fitted calibrator
validation.oos_scope: prefix walk-forward within the frozen 52-week snapshot; daily overlapping labels; 6-session sampled subset reported separately
